infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Mileage records the distance you drive so you can log trips for expenses.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Mileage needs Always access so it can detect the start and end of a drive while the app is closed. Without it, trips are missed.
